label: WRONG
reason: Per-resource enums (AccountPermissions, PatientPermissions, TokenPermissions) hold Permission entries and follow the suffix; the sole outlier PermissionContext in constants.py is a context-kind enum next to the Permission dataclass, a different kind of thing, so a new helper enum there would be flagged for nothing (R1 counted, 0 of 1). Hesitated with ACCEPT since the rule is otherwise a real naming scheme.
